newsitem.title: USA: Central Maine sees 619 MW unit on line Tues.
newsitem.headline: Central Maine sees 619 MW unit on line Tues.

text.p: Central Maine Power Co said it would restore the 619 megawatt (MW) Wyman 4 generating unit to operation Tuesday following its seasonal maintenance outage.
"It's back for testing Monday, and ready on line Tuesday," a company spokeswoman said.
The power unit in Yarmouth, Maine, which consumes residual fuel oil to produce electricity, was shut October 5.
Central Maine Power is the operator and majority owner of the Wyman 4 generating station.
